text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"After school! Worked hard at training 
today too! #Time #To #Unwind 
#CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Good work today, Curren-chan! Are you 
going somewhere after school?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yup♪ I'll go find something cute that'll 
make everyone smile☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-So cuuute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Curren Chan. She's a highly 
popular Umamusume on social media under 
the handle "Curren." And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was one girl gazing intently at 
Curren Chan from a distance.
choice_data_list: Do you need Curren for something, Yaeno?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whaaahaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
T-That startled me... Please don't scare 
me like that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...A-Ahem. You asked if I had business 
with Curren-san, correct? The answer is 
no.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I watched her, thinking just how 
magnificent her conduct and bearing were.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Even with daily life like that, she keeps 
up a frequent posting schedule on 
Umastagram. And that's on top of her busy 
training, too.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
She never lets the quality of her posts 
slip. As a result, her Umastagram is 
overflowing with cute things.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
!? I-I am not a fan! As a practitioner of 
the Kongo Yaegaki Style, my heart remains 
steadfast...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, there's a slight chance it could 
waver, but... her cuteness doesn't rely 
solely on talent; she's polished it 
thoroughly, so...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I even feel a sense of respect toward 
"Curren"-san... However, I wouldn't go so 
far as to call myself a fan...
choice_data_list: N-Next to you, right next to you...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Waaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, you were a fan of Curren? I'm 
so happy! My heart's racing ☆"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Please do a tandem run with me next time! 
And keep cheering for Curren, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I-I gotta protect them!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it, I cannot possibly leave such 
a lovely thing unattended...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must protect them with my Kongo Yaegaki 
Style...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Please!! Let me protect it...!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing♪ Does Curren finally have a 
bodyguard of her own!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, but what should I do! Curren is 
happy, but~ I'm a little worried you might 
be pushing yourself too hard?
choice_data_list: It's fine! Let's have them protect us!
Maybe we should calm them down first...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you're right! Curren's gotta step up 
so she doesn't lose to the fans' 
enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno-san, please protect Curren's 
cuteness, okay? ☆"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for agreeing to this 
interview today, Curren Chan-san. We're 
looking forward to speaking with you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, looking forward to it~♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: A-And so, umm... er, well...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, who is that intimidating person in 
the back...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno-san is Curren's knight in shining 
armor☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: K-Knight...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to Yaeno Muteki's intimidating 
presence... the reporters' questions 
seemed to soften up, as Curren Chan would 
recount later.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Curren's so super-cute it's 
hard to sit still! Then what we gotta do 
is...
choice_data_list: I'll have to say something un-cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehh~? I don't think I can do that☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because... there's never a moment when 
Curren isn't cute♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: C-Cute Curren C-h-a-a-a-n!!!
